meta.title: SpaceX position — pre-IPO holding vs the 6/12 IPO-day buy
meta.headline: The fund's SpaceX holding = the disclosed pre-IPO position (3/31 NPORT) PLUS a ~1.6M-share add on the 6/12 IPO day. The '$262M Friday buy' is that add valued at the 6/12 close.
meta.disclaimer: The IPO-day add is an ESTIMATE back-solved from 6/15's NAV (band $259-344M); the pre-IPO position is the disclosed 3/31 figure. Share count is split-adjusted (post 5-for-1).

derivation.detail: BPTIX NAV 289.98 -> 307.55 = +6.06%. SPCX 160.95 -> 192.50 = +19.6%. Public basket ~flat (+0.02% to +0.14% across the disclosed weightings).
For NAV +6.06% with a ~flat basket and SpaceX +19.6%, the start-of-Monday SpaceX weight must be (6.06% - basket)/(19.6% - basket) ~= 30.4% of net.
Carrying only the disclosed 3/31 shares: SpaceX $5.945B at the 6/12 close ($160.95) / AUM $20.4B = 29.14%.
30.4% implies SpaceX $ at the 6/12 close = 30.4% x $20.4B = $6.21B, vs the $5.945B no-buy mark -> ~$262M EXTRA SpaceX value was on the books Friday close = the IPO-day add.

$262M / $160.95 close = ~1.63M shares added. Cash spent = shares x the execution price: ~$220M if IPO-allocated at $135, ~$265M at the ~$162.91 VWAP. The $262M everyone quotes is the Friday-CLOSE marked value, not necessarily the cash.

pre_ipo.source: 3/31 NPORT-P SpaceX gross LMV, $1.25T merger mark
